algorithms.title: METHANE Radio Template
algorithms.description: Read it straight off the card. Target: under 60 seconds.
steps: E — Exact location: address/grid, side of building, landmarks.
T — Type: what happened (RTC, explosion, collapse, chemical, shooting).
H — Hazards: present and potential (fire, fuel, gas, chemicals, structure, violence, traffic, weather).
A — Access/egress: best route in, routes to avoid, staging/RV location.
N — Number: estimated total + red/yellow/green split + special groups (children, burns, contaminated).
E — Emergency services: who is on scene, what you request (ambulances, buses, HazMat, USAR, police, air).
Follow with CAN updates (Conditions, Actions, Needs) every 10–15 min or on major change.

algorithms.title: First-Due Crew Actions
algorithms.description: Two-person crew, first unit at an MCI.
steps: Approach with caution; stop short; position upwind/uphill/upstream and out of traffic.
Scan for hazards and CBRNE/hostile clues; if present — withdraw and report.
Crew 1: assume command, name the incident, declare MCI, send METHANE.
Crew 2: 360° recon + global sort (walkers to a collection point, wavers noted).
Request resources early and name the staging area.
As units arrive: assign Triage, Treatment, Transport, Staging; hand command up when a senior officer arrives (formal transfer).
